criteria.baseline_duration: The fresh v2 confirmation preregistered a separate two-e-folding check for both arms because their censoring windows differ. Retrospective NOT_APPLICABLE values mean that the older candidate-only schema had no separate baseline column; they must not be read as automatic baseline passes. For the E2 Gaussian corner the shared-window CIC baseline is measured and passes with 4.484 e-foldings.
criteria.duration: at least 2.0 model e-foldings for the measured arm
criteria.overall: PASS requires model, rate, duration, signal, protected-mode coverage and raw traceability all PASS
criteria.prediction_policy: predictions are reported separately and never satisfy a measurement gate
criteria.signal: fit-specific quality; E2 amplitude SNR >=5 and >=2 current-rate e-foldings where available
